purpose: Define the separation of discovery metadata, peer transport metadata, conversation membership and message payload exposure across Hello and messaging surfaces.

topics.name: Messaging Privacy Boundary
topics.purpose: Define the separation of discovery metadata, peer transport metadata, conversation membership and message payload exposure across Hello and messaging surfaces.

semantics.minimum_rule: Each layer exposes only metadata required for its own responsibility.
semantics.hello_rule: Hello service can observe only permitted bootstrap/discovery metadata, not normal message payload.
semantics.peer_rule: Conversation peers receive payload according to conversation membership and messaging policy.
semantics.monitor_rule: Operational monitors redact payload/content unless explicitly authorized for that surface.
semantics.identity_rule: Identity references may be pseudonymous/limited according to owning IAM/privacy policy without breaking exact internal refs.
semantics.retention_rule: Retention of message payload/history is explicit and separate from rendezvous-record TTL.
semantics.authority_rule: Metadata visibility at one layer does not grant visibility at another.

invariants.rule: Messaging is explicit peer/group communication over governed peer transport; rendezvous, transport, conversation policy and message payload remain separate semantic layers.

hard_gates.condition: rendezvous TTL used as message retention policy
transport metadata visibility grants payload access

references.purpose: Discovery metadata is isolated from payload.
